hookText: This seal has found a diver’s fin.
postingTitle: The Seal That Joined a Diver’s Survey 🦭
narrationScript: This seal has found a diver’s fin. First it comes right up to the camera, then turns its attention to the fin and keeps nosing around it. The underwater survey suddenly has a very enthusiastic visitor.

storyBeats.hook: This seal has found a diver’s fin.

storyBeats.payoff: The seal keeps returning to the fin during the underwater survey.
